JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Empire
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Empire: more noble titles, vassals, honours and noble visits for the Royalty Empire.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: It changes how guests are set up (guest status); guest mods may see visitors it changed.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hospitality (Continued)
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hospitality: visiting groups stay as hotel guests, rent beds, shop and eat, and can be befriended or recruited.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Hearth & Harbor is built as the successor of this mod and expects it to be switched off; run one of the two.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: Hearth & Harbor can take over a save that used it.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hospitality: Casino
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hospitality: Casino: gambling buildings for guests and colonists.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Hearth & Harbor is built as the successor of this mod and expects it to be switched off; run one of the two.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hospitality: Storefront
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hospitality: Storefront: a shop register and a selling job for social colonists.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Hearth & Harbor is built as the successor of this mod and expects it to be switched off; run one of the two.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hospitality: Spa
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hospitality: Spa: guests pay to use Dubs Bad Hygiene pools, hot tubs and saunas.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Hearth & Harbor is built as the successor of this mod and expects it to be switched off; run one of the two.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hospitality: Vending machines
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hospitality: Vending machines: powered machines where guests buy goods and meals themselves.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Hearth & Harbor is built as the successor of this mod and expects it to be switched off; run one of the two.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Hearth & Harbor – Guests, Hotels & Hospitality
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Hearth & Harbor: guests, hotels and hospitality with shops, casino, wellness and the Silverline bank.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: A JB mod with its own core (Hearth.Core); JB Framework mods detect it through the framework's Hearth adapter.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Silverline – Banking, Loans & Insurance
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Silverline: banking, loans and insurance, standalone or inside Hearth & Harbor.
